BY SUBMITTING YOUR VOTING INSTRUCTIONS ONLINE, YOU ARE CONFIRMING THE ANSWER FOR A, B AND C TO BE 'NO' AND THE ANSWER FOR D TO BE 'YES'. A MANAGEMENT COMPANY WITH A LICENSE FROM THE CAPITAL MARKET, INSURANCE AND SAVINGS AUTHORITY COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL OR 2. AN INSURER WITH A FOREIGN INSURER LICENSE FROM THE COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL. THEREFORE, A MANAGEMENT COMPANY IS A COMPANY WITH A LICENSE FROM THE CAPITAL MARKET, INSURANCE AND SAVINGS AUTHORITY COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL. PENSION FUND - RECEIVED APPROVAL UNDER SECTION 13 OF THE LAW FROM THE CAPITAL MARKET, INSURANCE AND SAVINGS AUTHORITY COMMISSIONER IN ISRAEL.

THIS TRANSFER WILL NEED TO BE COMPLETED BY THE SPECIFIED CREST SYSTEM DEADLINE. ONCE THIS TRANSFER HAS SETTLED, THE CDIS WILL BE BLOCKED IN THE CREST SYSTEM. IN ORDER FOR A VOTE TO BE ACCEPTED, THE VOTED POSITION MUST BE BLOCKED IN THE REQUIRED ESCROW ACCOUNT IN THE CREST SYSTEM. BY VOTING ON THIS MEETING, YOUR CREST SPONSORED MEMBER/CUSTODIAN MAY USE YOUR VOTE INSTRUCTION AS THE AUTHORIZATION TO TAKE THE NECESSARY ACTION WHICH WILL INCLUDE TRANSFERRING YOUR INSTRUCTED POSITION TO ESCROW. PLEASE CONTACT YOUR CREST SPONSORED MEMBER/CUSTODIAN DIRECTLY FOR FURTHER INFORMATION ON THE CUSTODY PROCESS AND WHETHER OR NOT THEY REQUIRE SEPARATE INSTRUCTIONS FROM YOU
